scheme_name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty
other_conditions: Only new units/projects are eligible for reimbursement.
Developer must have paid Stamp Duty on the purchase of required land during the operative period of the scheme.
Reimbursement is tied to the completion of specific project milestones, such as purchasing all required land and completing at least 40% of construction.
benefits_summary: Developers can recover the Stamp Duty paid on land purchase for new logistics projects.
